fields.description: Issue includes local political commentary and civic advocacy, including discussion of taxation and calls for government economy; coverage of a Miami Beach divorce controversy involving Joseph E. Jacobson and an alleged fraudulent letter seeking medical records; reporting on Florida public health priorities regarding premature infant deaths; criticism of access to emergency medical care at Jackson Memorial Hospital; opposition to dredge-and-fill development in Biscayne Bay; and labor-related commentary on a newspaper strike and union solidarity. Also includes arts and entertainment items (University of Miami Symphony Orchestra concert at Miami Senior High School) and substantial local advertising.
